name: Breadcrumb
summary: The path from the home page to the current page, as a row of links with drawn separators.
description: Use it on pages more than one level deep so people can see where they are and step back up. It does not replace the main navigation.

classes.name: v-breadcrumb
classes.description: On the <nav> around an <ol>. Draws chevron separators that point the other way in right-to-left text.

states.description: On the last item, a <span>: bold, not a link, cut with an ellipsis if it is too long.

a11y: Wrap it in <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"> so it is listed as its own landmark.
Use an ordered list, so screen readers announce how many levels there are.
The separators are drawn in CSS, so they are not read out.
